title: IRM Unable to Send SMS to Thailand, Bangladesh, and Austrian Numbers

updates.body:
We are currently investigating an issue impacting all SMS attempts to Austria for IRM. All SMS attempts to Austria for IRM are currently blocked. We are working on a resolution, and an update will follow as soon as we have more info.

Users should configure mobile push or phone calls as notifications.

title: Grafana Cloud k6 – Brief metrics unavailability

updates.body: A transient issue prevented Grafana Cloud k6 from serving metrics to a small number of customers for approximately 3–4 minutes. The issue has been resolved, and normal service has been restored.
